record.abstract: TruLens 2.14.0 Release Notes Headline Features Coding Agent Instrumentation Instrument IDE hooks and coding agent workflows — including Claude Code and Cursor — with TruLens tracing. Capture the full execution trace of agentic coding sessions for evaluation and observability. (#2732) by @joshreini1 Production Trace Curation into Evaluation Datasets Curate production traces into persisted evaluation datasets. Select and save real-world traces directly from your running application, building ground-truth datasets for offline evaluation without manual data collection. (#2722) by @Payal2000 Connector-Backed Prompt Management with Version Evaluation Store, version, and evaluate prompt templates through the connector interface. Track prompt changes over time and evaluate the impact of prompt edits against your existing datasets and feedback functions. (#2717) by @dylanpulver OTLP-Native Export and OTel Metrics Signal Export traces and metrics directly via the OpenTelemetry Protocol, enabling integration with any OTLP-compatible backend. (#2681) by @RyanFlowerYes Additional Features Streaming token tracking with TTFT and throughput metrics — OTEL instrumentation now captures streaming token counts, time-to-first-token, and throughput for LLM calls. (#2708) by @Abelo9996 Ollama provider — New trulens-providers-ollama package for running feedback functions against local Ollama models. (#2688) by @connectsudhindra-gif Conversation metric customization — additional_instructions and chain-of-thought reasons support for conversation-scoped metrics. (#2710) by @dylanpulver Dashboard Improvements Leaderboard record counts — Leaderboard metrics now show how many records each metric actually scored. (#2698) by @CTWalk TTFT in the Records page — Time-to-first-token is now visible in the latency view on the Records page. (#2696) by @connectsudhindra-gif Conversation thread column labels — Conversation-scoped thread columns are now labeled "latest" instead of "avg" to reflect their actual semantics. (#2750) by @Abelo9996 Topic Adherence score consistency — Topic Adherence scores now match between the results table and conversation metrics view. (#2733) by @Abelo9996 Bug Fixes LLM judge rating extraction — Fixed a bug where the judge's stated scale description was incorrectly parsed as its numeric rating. (#2726) by @arthi-arumugam-git ndcg_at_k shape crash and cohens_kappa label mutation — ndcg_at_k no longer crashes on mismatched shapes; cohens_kappa no longer mutates its input labels. (#2709) by @ClaireXi99 Ground-truth row ordering — Benchmark scoring now processes ground-truth rows in row order, not index-label order. (#2737) by @arthi-arumugam-git IR metric undefined results — IR metrics now report nan instead of 0.0 when undefined (e.g., empty relevance lists). (#2738) by @arthi-arumugam-git Duplicate chunk handling in IR metrics — recall_at_k and ndcg_at_k are now correctly bounded when retrieved chunks contain duplicates. (#2747) by @Abelo9996 Temperature argument for conversation metrics — temperature stays positional on conversation metric calls, fixing a regression. (#2728) by @BetterAndBetterII Dataset and ground-truth read round-trips — Fixed serialization round-trip errors when reading datasets and ground-truth entries from the database. (#2735) by @Abelo9996 Feedback definition re-insert — Feedback definition updates are now persisted correctly on re-insert. (#2743) by @Abelo9996 compute_metrics message formatting — Status messages now build from metric names, not raw objects. (#2745) by @Abelo9996 Anthropic cost tracking — Fixed a crash in the Anthropic provider when tracking costs via core_endpoint.Cost. (#2756) by @Abelo9996 methods_to_instrument existence check — App wrappers now use Lens.get for safer instrumentation target checks. (#2754) by @Abelo9996 OpenAI moderation_harassment_threatening — This moderation method now reads the correct category from the API response. (#2752) by @Abelo9996 OTEL tracing default cleanup — Removed stale enablement references; TruLens now warns when OTEL tracing is explicitly disabled. (#2724) by @sfc-gh-jreini Ruff version alignment — All three ruff pins are now aligned on 0.16.3. (#2720) by @dylanpulver Conda recipe updates — Conda recipes updated for TruLens 2.13.0. (#2713) by @sfc-gh-jreini Missing docstring fix — Added missing docstring on public function pytest_collection_modi. (#2706) by @nickhac New example Trace debugging cookbook — New notebook walking through common trace debugging workflows. record.title: thurlow-research/HumanOversightSystem: HOS v0.6.0
record.abstract: v0.6.0 — Astro & JS Support Theme: Give an Astro / JS-TS consumer the same deterministic signal density and stack depth a Django consumer gets today; harden worker/overseer governance surfaced during the build. 97 issues closed. Epic: #1029. Milestone drained 2026-08-12 (#1330). Headline: JS/TS and Astro are first-class stacks Before this release, the 12-dimension signal layer was implicitly Django/Python-only: on an all-.astro/.ts/.js changeset every PY_FILES-gated validator skipped, so roughly half the scoring dimensions went dark, and there was no pack giving the base team JS/Astro idioms. A two-layer pack closes that gap — a generic node pack (reusable for future Next/SvelteKit work) plus an astro pack layered on it via pack.toml requires = ["node"]. Foundation Language-aware JS_FILES routing in run_validators.sh — the root dependency every JS validator hangs off (S1) JS toolchain discovery helper, ensure_node (S2), and installer pack.toml requires DFS-closure resolution — net-new parsing, hos_install.sh --pack astro now pulls in node automatically (S3, D3) JS/TS validators — six new validators giving JS/TS changesets the same signal density as Python: complexity_metrics_js.py — tree-sitter AST cyclomatic complexity, not eslint's rule or escomplex (S4, D4/D5) function_metrics_js.py — length/params/return-paths, .astro frontmatter/ extracted via regex fence scan (S5) static_analysis_js.py — semgrep with a vendored ruleset, sole engine for JS (not additive like Python/bandit) (S6, D6) rn_calculator_js.py — Risk Number, provisional: reuses Python's Dai et al. weights, explicitly flagged "provisional-js-reuses-python-weights" pending dogfood calibration data (S8, D7) n1_detector_js.py — fetch/await-in-loop heuristic, marked provisional pending dogfood data (S9, D8) hallucination-surface: npm ecosystem + package.json dependency-existence check (S7) All new validators emit the shared schema.py envelope and are language-gated by file extension in the shared validators/ directory, not pack-discovered (D10). Gates lint_check.sh — eslint gate for JS/TS (S10) type_check.sh — tsc --noEmit, defers to S12 on Astro projects (S11) astro_check.sh — astro sync then astro check, not a build (S12, D9) Pack agent depth packs/node/ — base agent pack body, review-lens "find-the-defect" framing, spec-derived test independence (S13-S15) packs/astro/ — same three layers on top of node via requires (S16-S18) Node/JS toolchain policy: resolved from the consumer's own toolchain, never force-installed — node_modules/.bin → npx --no-install probe → PATH, floor Node ≥22, fail-hard preflight (D1, D2). AC-6 (dogfood field report) — waived at ship. No field report from a real Astro project exists. Human decision 2026-08-12 (#1330): ship with AC-6 outstanding rather than block the release on it; a Tutelare field report, if it happens, files as a standalone issue against whatever milestone is active then and does not reopen v0.6.0. Governance & process hardening A large share of this milestone was process-gap and governance work surfaced while building the Astro pack under the autonomous worker/overseer loop, not Astro-specific: Canonical write/read scripts committed — bootstrap/create_issue.sh, submit_pr.sh, edit_issue.sh, query_issues.sh, post_comment.sh, revoke_app_token.sh — closing the pattern where every issue/PR interaction hand-rolled its own gh + token-mint preamble (#1085, #1175, #1191, #1192, #1204, #1213) Stale-base PR protection — submit_pr.sh now merges from base before pushing, fail-closed on conflicts; closes the class of bug where a stale local branch silently proposed reverting already-merged work (#1162, #1166) Worker throughput unblocked from serialized human merge — bin/hos-cron is now the single decision authority for whether a cycle may pick new work vs. must fix an existing PR (#1198, #1230, #1236) Validation-stamp gate repaired three times in-milestone after regressions on main blocked all PR merges (#1323, #1333, #1367) Overseer PR-review clarity — every comment now leads with recommendation + expected action + what could not be checked (#1099, #1268); review-thread posting/resolution bugs fixed so findings are actually visible and gate merge (#1207, #1208, #1248, #1259, #1272) Overseer merge-authority gates hardened — protected-surface/CODEOWNERS check can no longer be skipped (#1325), human-authorized-merge idempotency (#1250), head-SHA freshness on the protected-surface bypass (#1251), defined signal source for the "security-relevant" gate (#1253) Fail-honestly / fail-closed fixes — validators no longer report "clean" when the underlying scanner failed to run (#1087); run_validators.sh tier-floor hoisting no longer masks a HIGH security floor (#1052); validate_self.sh no longer reports PASS when its reviewer invocation fails silently (#1362, #1365) — this fix is what let the release-validation gate below run for real for the first time and surface its own structural limits, rather than false-passing them Model currency — all 30 shipped agents were pinned to previous-generation model IDs; corrected (#1122) Coverage/mutation scope gap — the #314 shell→Python migration's own modules (including merge_authority.py) were excluded from coverage and mutation testing; fixed (#1174) Token/credential handling — get_app_token.sh callers no longer need to touch the token output file to verify a mint succeeded (#1086); a live token hand-copied into settings.local.json was found and flagged for manual removal (#1307) Documentation CLAUDE.md sandbox guidance corrected (unmatched commands are denied, not hung) and the "search first" step made explicit and required (#1184, #1214) worker.md / overseer.md updated to prefer canonical scripts, with a script inventory (#1311) docs/planning/README.md retired v0.5.1 as a triage target (#1193); v0.6.0 marked shipped and its D1-D10 open-decisions table reconciled against the actually-shipped code (#1337) Upgrade notes Pack install: hos_install.sh --pack astro now resolves and injects node automatically via pack.toml requires; --pack node still installs standalone. New validator dependencies: the six JS validators need tree-sitter/tree_sitter_typescript, semgrep, and a discoverable Node ≥22 toolchain. None are force-installed — see lib/detect_stack.sh / lib/resolve_node_tool.sh for the discovery order. Missing tools are now caught in preflight rather than silently going inert (#1266). Provisional signals: the JS Risk Number calculator and N+1 analog reuse Python's calibration weights and are explicitly flagged provisional in their output — treat their scores as directional until dogfood data recalibrates them. hos_install.sh: re-run to pick up the node/astro packs and the committed canonical scripts above. Release validation — what ran, what didn't (NG3b Step R2, issue #1338) v0.6.0 is the first HOS release to attempt an aggregate cross-vendor review at all — every prior release shipped with zero. It was cut under a human-authorized partial waiver rather than a clean 5-of-5 gate. Recorded here in full rather than absorbed silently: Green (deterministic, re-run at the cut SHA): ✅ run_tests_release.sh — 2578 passed, 0 failed ✅ check_agents_static.sh — 0 findings ✅ run_validators.sh (diff since v0.5.0) — 12/12 validators succeeded, composite 0.6559 → tier HIGH Waived, with substitute evidence (human decision, 2026-08-14): ⚠️ validate_self.sh (Opus self-review) — invocation fails on this release's diff size: getconf ARG_MAX (2,097,152 B) is exceeded by the 70-file, 2,028,660 B .claude/agents+docs changeset passed as a single CLI argument. Root-caused and filed as #1368 (fix: pass via stdin/file instead of argv — small, mechanical, not yet built). Accepted: suites below are sufficient evidence for this release; #1368 lands as a normal v0.7.0 follow-up. ⚠️ run_second_review.sh (cross-vendor second review) — failed identically 3 times in a row on the prior HEAD with the same diff-size structural cause (#1355), consuming ≈4.0M agy tokens (≈201% of the monthly plan allotment) and ≈3.2M codex tokens (≈644%) for zero signal. Withheld rather than retried a 4th time. Waived in favor of: The existing per-PR second-review chain, which already covered all 18 S1–S18 build-step PRs individually before each merged. A manual, hand-run chunked cross-vendor review of the full release diff (16 chunks ≤80KB each, strict risk order): Tier 1 (7 chunks, 49% of source by size) completed 2026-08-13/14 — 13 of 14 agy/codex invocations produced a real review, 15 findings surfaced. Triage so far: 1 CRITICAL reproduced and disproven (false positive, a set -e semantics misread); of 5 further-verified HIGHs, 2 confirmed real and filed (#1369, #1380), 3 were false positives — notably all 3 false positives were agy's and both real findings were codex's, a useful vendor-reliability signal for future runs. Remaining HIGH/MEDIUM findings are individually tracked, unverified, see #1338. Tier 2 (5 chunks) and Tier 3 (agent/pack prose, lowest risk) were not run — a deliberate, quota-bounded stop, not an oversight. cut_release.sh's own internal validation gate (self-review + agy/codex semantic review over .claude/agents+docs) was likewise not run live for this cut — same ARG_MAX wall on the self-review half, and the same exhausted agy/codex quota on the other. The Tier 1 manual review above covers materially the same surface and is offered as substitute evidence for this gate too. Net: every deterministic gate is green at the cut SHA. Both model-mediated gates were attempted for real — not silently skipped — and both hit the same understood structural bug (a release-spanning diff too large for a single CLI invocation) rather than surfacing a content finding. The manual chunked review supplies real cross-vendor signal in their place. Full evidence, calibration notes, and the open triage queue live on #1338 and its linked issues (#
